Hi Tomas,

just something I picked up at the truck stop this morning. A guy there was going on about how 60 drivers from Kestrel Haulage Ltd would get called up if things escalate. I can't confirm this, no idea where he got it from, so I'm only passing it on. Probably nothing, but thought you'd want to hear it.

If you catch wind of anything more solid, let me know.

Nils
